linux.notes: AUDIT 11 (review stays): independent recompute with the drawn popover shadow: dropdown-open 0 flat px off (glyphs excluded; the top 22 rows, where the sheet draws the button, ignored) and the shadow matches the 2.0 render against the @2x capture within 3 levels. But the drop-down arrow is 7 px left of the capture's (ours x 129 to 140, GTK x 136 to 147 in the 160 px crop) in normal, hover, active, focus, disabled and open-button: 33 flat px and 37 steep px off per state, up to 184 levels, so the earlier 'every state 0 flat px' only holds with the arrow counted as a glyph. Symbolic icons count, so combo box stays review. Focus rings: dropdown-focus-ring 39 steep px off (ring corners, up to 10 levels), combo-entry-focus 53; the first manifest's dropdown-focus is a different capture of the ring (1 px plus a fractional px, 770 steep px off in Light) that ours does not follow. The combo-entry arrow is in its own button and matches (0 flat). | ROUND 21 (shadow worker): the popover's soft shadow is drawn (three blurred rounded-rectangle layers fitted to the alpha of dropdown-open@1x, sized by the popover), the baked 9-slice and its generator are deleted. scripts/linux_cmp_shadow.py: every state of combo_box and combo_box_open 0 flat px off in both schemes; steep pixels off: focus-ring states 39 / 53 (Light), 48 / 58 (Dark), dark active 17, open list 60 / 32 (before, painter disabled: open list 2066 / 508 flat). Stays review, not matched: the focus ring corners are off by up to 10 levels on those steep pixels and the popover's offset below the button is a guess. Scale check passes at 1.25, 1.5 and 2.0 (closed and open sheets).
gaps: The drop-down arrow sits 7 px left of GTK's (33 flat and 37 steep px per state)

Focus ring corners: GTK's 2 px outline has a 6 px outer and 4 px inner corner; ours is a border at radius 5.7, whose antialiasing differs by up to 10 levels on about 40 corner pixels per ring (the straight sides match)
The gap between the button and its popover (7.07 px) is a guess: the capture holds the popover surface alone
Hover and pressed are the library with state flags forced, not a real pointer
Rows are 35.5 px in GTK; Neper snaps box heights to whole pixels, so the second and third rows' text can sit 0.5 px off
The combo box with an entry opens the same popover list (only the drop down's was captured)
